name: Visitor counter renders a live count from the API
description: The hero social-proof counter must display a real number from the visitor-count API (above the base value of 247) with a '++' suffix, not a loading skeleton.

planSteps.description: The hero counter next to the avatar stack shows a numeric value greater than 200 ending with '++' (for example '248++'), with the caption 'pengguna sudah mencoba bot ini' below it
